name: Campingplatz Seespitz - Plansee
beschreibung:
Situated right on the shores of fjord-like Lake Plansee in the Tyrolean Ausserfern, Campingplatz Seespitz enchants nature lovers and active adventurers alike. Towering mountain slopes and turquoise waters create a breathtaking alpine backdrop.

From the campsite, guests can swim, dive, stand-up paddle across crystal waters, or climb prominent peaks in the Ammergau and Lechtal Alps.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Seespitz at Lake Plansee offers a spectacular setting on Tyrol's second-largest lake in the Reutte Nature Park.
